en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Dag. I ride with the Bowl Farmers, the patrol that keeps the roads near these walls. Keep your guns cold inside the gate and we'll get along fine.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What is the road like?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Any work?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who pays the Farmers?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who are the raiders?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of Nose?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^How does Bowl pay the raiders?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_kiln"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do tenants serve with you?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_pay"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Does the patrol go out to the crater?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do you know where that Army wagon is?","/str","str","^wagonBowl","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},{"VAR?":"dag_wagon"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Nobody raided that wagon.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_saw"},{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^What did the well house make of it?","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^told","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Dusty, and worse every season. A truck that breaks down out there waits a long time for a friendly face, so carry water and a spare belt, and don't wander off the track.","
","^Raiders sniff around the roads too. It's nothing we can't run off, but you'll want your gun ready.","
","^The Army at <term=nose>Nose</term> watches the stretch in front of its own gate, and it does that well enough.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_road","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
",["ev",{"x()":"board_full"},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You're carrying enough promises already. Finish a few and then ask me again.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!",{"x()":"has_offers"},"&&","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^There's nothing on the board you could take right now. Make some room on your truck and ask again.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The board's empty today. Come back in a couple of days. It fills slowly.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],"nop","
","^I might have a haul for you, if you want it. ","#","^work_offer","/#","
",["ev","str","^I will take it.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not now.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",{"x()":"take_work"},"pop","/ev","
","^Good. Bowl remembers the people who deliver. Bring it in on time.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-2":["
","^Not enough people, to be plain. The <term=granary>Granary</term> pays out of its count of sacks, the long convoys pay a fee, and the tenants put in a share of their harvest.","
","^Nose pays nothing, because it guards only its own walls. So each town watches the road by its own gate and nobody watches between the towns. I don't like it, and I don't know a cure.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_pay","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^There are two camps. Kiln Camp sits out south-east, south-west of the big crater, and <term=scrapjaw>Scrapjaw Camp</term> is far up north. Most days they'd rather rob you than kill you, because a dead driver hauls nothing next week.","
","^So pay them or outrun them, and never fire the first shot.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^The Army's all right on the road. Off it, they act as though the basin belongs to them and the rest of us are only borrowing it. Bowl was feeding people long before Nose built its workshop line.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The Granary pays Kiln Camp a sack of grain for every armed truck that crosses their road. It costs less than a funeral.","
","^If they close on you anyway, fight hard. They often let a hard fighter go, and they strip a soft one down to the frame. Just don't start the fight.","
","ev","str","^talkKilnFight","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Some do. They're good drivers, but tenants have no vote. They ride in our coats and stay off the roll of citizens. The <term=senate>Senate</term> wants them on the road and off the roll.","
","^Jory Baptiste keeps sending more of them, and I can't decide whether to thank him or watch him.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","ev",{"x()":"cult_broken"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^By day it does, and by night as well now. The lamps stopped crossing at dusk, and nobody has gone missing off the rim road since. Still keep off the green glow, whatever the hour.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^By day, yes. After dark, no, and that goes for every truck I ride with. Lamps cross the open ground out there at dusk and go back before sunup. A truck that stops by the rim at night isn't always there in the morning. Be off the crater road before sundown.","
","ev","str","^sunwardDragged","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^I do. She's in a hollow below the bend in our north road, below where the <term=pump_station>Pump Station</term> track branches off. East of here. I rode down to her myself.","
","^Rule first: take nothing from that hollow up to Nose. Nose blames the first driver it finds near its guns, and then it sends trucks down my road to ask questions.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_wagon","re":true},"ev","str","^wagonDag","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^No. I walked that hollow too. Not one casing in the grit, and not a hole in her. Whatever stove in that cab was the slope, not a gun.","
","^Nose says raiders, and every driver who buys water here believes it. If you want it said, say it at the well house where they all drink. I'll stand next to you while you do.","
",["ev","str","^Say it at the well house.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not yet.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^told","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"^You say it at Hattie's, plainly, to whoever is holding a cup: no brass, no holes, every dent from the slope. Dag stands next to you and says he counted the same. ","#","^page","/#","
","^A woman at the cistern puts her bucket down. Her son rode in the cab of that wagon, she says. Nobody had told her there was no fight.","
","^Two Nose soldiers buying water hear every word. They fill their drums and leave without talking to each other.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-10":["
","^Bowl talks over its cups, and Nose soldiers drink from the same well. Now they ask the Farmers whose brakes hold. I don't mind that question.","
","^I still want Nose trucks off my road. Before, they'd have come down asking who stripped their wagon. Now they'd come asking who told.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_road"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_pay"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_wagon"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Даг. Я из патруля Чаши, мы держим дороги у этих стен. Внутри ворот стволы не доставай, и поладим.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Что с дорогой?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Есть работа?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Кто платит патрулю?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Кто эти рейдеры?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что думаешь о Носе?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Как Чаша платит рейдерам?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_kiln"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Арендаторы ездят с вами?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_pay"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Патруль ходит к кратеру?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Знаешь, где тот армейский фургон?","/str","str","^wagonBowl","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},{"VAR?":"dag_wagon"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Тот фургон рейдеры не трогали.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_saw"},{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что колодезная об этом думает?","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^told","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Пыльная, и с каждым сезоном хуже. Если грузовик сломается там, добрую душу придется ждать долго. Так что вози воду и запасной ремень. И с колеи не сходи.","
","^Рейдеры тоже шастают вдоль дорог. Отогнать их нам по силам, но пушку держи наготове.","
","^Армия с <term=nose>Носа</term> присматривает за участком перед своими воротами. Присматривает сносно.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_road","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
",["ev",{"x()":"board_full"},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^На тебе и так висит куча обещаний. Выполни пару, потом спрашивай.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!",{"x()":"has_offers"},"&&","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^На доске сейчас нет ничего, что ты можешь взять. Освободи место в грузовике, потом спроси снова.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Доска сегодня пустая. Загляни через пару дней. Она наполняется медленно.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],"nop","
","^Может, найдется для тебя рейс, если хочешь. ","#","^work_offer","/#","
",["ev","str","^Беру.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Не сейчас.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",{"x()":"take_work"},"pop","/ev","
","^Добро. Чаша помнит тех, кто довозит груз. Довези в срок.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-2":["
","^Если прямо, платят немногие. <term=granary>Элеватор</term> платит мешками из своих запасов, длинные конвои платят сбор, арендаторы отдают долю урожая.","
","^Нос не платит ничего: он охраняет только свои стены. Каждый город смотрит за дорогой у своих ворот, а между городами не смотрит никто. Мне это не нравится. Как это лечить, не знаю.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_pay","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Лагерей два. Лагерь Обжиг стоит на юго-востоке, к юго-западу от большого кратера. Лагерь <term=scrapjaw>Ржавая Челюсть</term> далеко на севере. Чаще всего они лучше ограбят, чем убьют: мертвый водитель на следующей неделе ничего не привезет.","
","^Так что плати или уходи от погони, и никогда не стреляй первым.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^На дороге с армией можно иметь дело. Вне дороги они ведут себя так, будто котловина принадлежит им, а все остальные здесь на птичьих правах. Чаша кормила людей задолго до того, как Нос построил свою мастерскую линию.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Элеватор платит лагерю Обжиг мешок зерна за каждый вооруженный грузовик, который проезжает по их дороге. Это дешевле похорон.","
","^Если они всё равно навалятся, бейся всерьез. Кто крепко дает отпор, того часто отпускают. Слабого раздевают до рамы. Только первым драку не начинай.","
","ev","str","^talkKilnFight","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Кое-кто ездит. Водители хорошие, но у арендаторов голоса нет. Они ездят в наших куртках и в списке граждан не значатся. <term=senate>Сенат</term> хочет, чтобы они были на дороге, но не в списке.","
","^Джори Батист шлет и шлет новых. Не пойму, то ли благодарить его, то ли приглядывать за ним.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","ev",{"x()":"cult_broken"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Днем ходит, а теперь и по ночам тоже. В сумерках огни перестали ходить, и с тех пор на дороге у края никто не пропадал. Но к зеленому свечению всё равно не приближайся, в любой час.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Днем — да. После темноты — нет, и это касается каждого грузовика, с которым я хожу. В сумерках по открытой земле там ходят огни и возвращаются до рассвета. Грузовик, который встанет на ночь у края, утром находят не всегда. Уходи с дороги у кратера до заката.","
","ev","str","^sunwardDragged","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Знаю. Он лежит в лощине под поворотом нашей северной дороги, ниже того места, где отходит колея к <term=pump_station>Насосной станции</term>. Отсюда на восток. Я сам спускался к нему.","
","^Правило первое: ничего из той лощины на Нос не вози. Нос винит первого водителя, которого найдет рядом со своими пушками, а потом шлет по моей дороге грузовики с вопросами.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_wagon","re":true},"ev","str","^wagonDag","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Нет. Я ту лощину тоже обошел. В песке ни одной гильзы, в нем самом ни одной дыры. Кабину смяло при падении по склону, а не выстрелом.","
","^Нос говорит: рейдеры. И каждый водитель, который покупает здесь воду, верит. Хочешь, чтобы услышали, скажи в колодезной, где все пьют. Я постою рядом.","
",["ev","str","^Сказать в колодезной.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Пока нет.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^told","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"^Вы говорите это у Хэтти, прямо, каждому с кружкой в руке: ни гильз, ни дыр, все вмятины от падения по склону. Даг стоит рядом и говорит, что сам видел то же. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Женщина у цистерны ставит ведро. Её сын ехал в кабине этого фургона, говорит она. Никто ей не сказал, что боя не было.","
","^Двое солдат с Носа, которые покупают воду, слышат каждое слово. Они наполняют бочки и уходят, не разговаривая между собой.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-10":["
","^Чаша разговаривает за кружкой, а солдаты Носа пьют из того же колодца. Теперь они спрашивают патруль, чьи тормоза надежны. Против такого вопроса я ничего не имею.","
","^Грузовики Носа на моей дороге мне всё равно не нужны. Раньше они приехали бы спросить, кто раздел их фургон. Теперь приедут спросить, кто проболтался.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_road"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_pay"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_wagon"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Pull up by the well. I'm Hattie. Where'd you come from, and how much water do you need?","
","^<term=bowl>Bowl</term> grows food behind that gate.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Tell me about the tow man.","/str",{"VAR?":"towed_to_bowl"},{"VAR?":"hattie_tow"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who stripped my truck?","/str",{"VAR?":"towed_to_bowl"},{"x()":"engine_missing"},"&&",{"VAR?":"hattie_strip"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Heard any rumors?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_rumor"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Any local legends?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_flats"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who comes through here?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who asks about the Granary?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},{"VAR?":"hattie_granary"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the soldiers from Nose?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},{"VAR?":"hattie_soldiers"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Will the Nose soldiers stop me on the road?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_soldiers"},{"VAR?":"hattie_roads"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^What if I go up to Nose unarmed?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_roads"},{"VAR?":"hattie_unarmed"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^What about the glass at the Glass Flats?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_flats"},{"VAR?":"hattie_glass"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do the Sunward do with strangers?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_glass"},{"VAR?":"hattie_sunward"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^Have the Sunward gone quiet?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_sunward"},{"x()":"cult_broken"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":5},"ev","str","^Have you seen anyone come out of the crater?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_sunward"},{"VAR?":"hattie_came_out"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-12","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-13","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The tag on his chain is old <term=pierce>Pierce</term> yard stock. Before the crews took the yard, Pierce hung one on every key and chain.","
","^Yours matches.","
","^He found your truck dead in the badlands, you in the seat. He took the lot for abandoned and hooked it up.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_tow","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Wasn't the tow man, if that's where you're looking. Whoever it was took their time and left you breathing.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_strip","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^A scavenger came through selling a <term=nose>Nose</term> Army radio. Said he took it off a dead wagon in the hills east of here. That's his story, not mine.","
","^The patrol asked where exactly. He filled his tank and took the west road before dark.","
","ev","str","^wagonBowl","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_rumor","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^One driver swears an Old World tank still runs out on the <term=glass_flats>Glass Flats</term>. Comes out at night with its lights off.","
","^I only ever saw him drink.","
","ev","str","^glassTank","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_flats","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Traders, couriers, fuel haulers. Soldiers from Nose, thirsty as ever. Then the quiet ones, asking after the <term=granary>Granary</term> and never buying a drop.","
","^Those worry me. Water's a funny thing to forget at a well.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_strangers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Drivers with empty beds. The raiders pay them to count the Granary's grain.","
","^Odile chalks the count on the gate every night, so all they need is somebody who can read.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_granary","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They pay for water like guests and give orders like owners.","
","^They say please, then stand there till it's done.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_soldiers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^No, and they won't stop whoever comes to take your truck either.","
","^Nobody keeps the road between the towns, and Kiln riders strip any truck that can't fight and won't pay.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_roads","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Nose will let you in unarmed, sure.","
","^Out again too, gun or no gun. I only heard Pierce won't insure a truck without one.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_unarmed","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Pim Arslan says every ripple in that glass leans toward the <term=fallen_sun>Fallen Sun</term> crater.","
","^The <term=sunward>Sunward</term> say it's bowing to what's down there. That's what I've heard. I won't stand on it at noon.","
","ev","str","^talkGlassLean","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_glass","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^They take them into the crater. The ones who come out are green at the edges and quiet.","
","^I've never been in, and I never will.","
","ev","str","^talkSunwardTake","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_sunward","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^Quiet as a dry well. Bo's cousin says the lamps stopped crossing to the crater at dusk. And a man with a green shine on his hands came to my well asking where a body could sleep. Well, Bo's cousin says a lot of things. You look like you'd know more about it than he does.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^I saw one at dusk once, a woman with her hands shining green. She emptied bucket after bucket without a word.","
","^She didn't pay. Then she walked back toward the crater.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_came_out","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"towed_to_bowl"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Safe road. That line on my slate won't clear itself. ",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ Come back when you've got M's for water. Keep all your wheels till then. ",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],"nop","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_rumor"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_flats"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_glass"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_sunward"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_strangers"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_granary"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_soldiers"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_roads"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_came_out"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_tow"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_strip"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_unarmed"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Отгони свое корыто от колодца, водила, и скажи, сколько воды надо. Я Хэтти. Деньги беру за воду, а советы бесплатно, ты их все равно мимо ушей пропустишь.","
","^В <term=bowl>Чаше</term> за теми воротами еду растят. А водилы здесь, у меня, пока баки не наполнят.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Расскажи про буксировщика.","/str",{"VAR?":"towed_to_bowl"},{"VAR?":"hattie_tow"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Кто ободрал мой грузовик?","/str",{"VAR?":"towed_to_bowl"},{"x()":"engine_missing"},"&&",{"VAR?":"hattie_strip"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Слухи есть?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_rumor"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Местные легенды есть?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_flats"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Кто тут проезжает?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Кто расспрашивает про Элеватор?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},{"VAR?":"hattie_granary"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что скажешь про солдат с Носа?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},{"VAR?":"hattie_soldiers"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Солдаты с Носа остановят меня на дороге?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_soldiers"},{"VAR?":"hattie_roads"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^А если приехать на Нос без пушки?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_roads"},{"VAR?":"hattie_unarmed"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что со стеклом на Стеклянной равнине?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_flats"},{"VAR?":"hattie_glass"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что Обращенные к Солнцу делают с чужаками?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_glass"},{"VAR?":"hattie_sunward"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^Обращенные к Солнцу затихли?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_sunward"},{"x()":"cult_broken"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":5},"ev","str","^А кто-нибудь выходил из кратера на твоих глазах?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_sunward"},{"VAR?":"hattie_came_out"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-12","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-13","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^На его цепи старая бирка со двора «<term=pierce>Пирса</term>». До того как бригады заняли двор, «Пирс» вешал такие бирки на каждый свой ключ и каждую цепь.","
","^Бирка на твоем ключе тоже с того двора.","
","^Он нашел твой грузовик в пустошах. Стоит, не едет, а в кресле ты. Решил, что грузовик бросили, зацепил и притащил сюда вместе с тобой.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_tow","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Не буксировщик, если ты на него думаешь. Кто ободрал, тот не спешил, а тебя в живых оставил.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_strip","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^На днях тут один мусорщик рацию армии <term=nose>Носа</term> продавал, говорил, снял с подбитой машины в холмах к востоку от Чаши.","
","^А как патруль спросил, где именно, он залил бак и до темноты укатил по западной дороге.","
","ev","str","^wagonBowl","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_rumor","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Один водила клянется, что по <term=glass_flats>Стеклянной равнине</term> до сих пор ездит танк старого мира. По ночам выезжает, без огней.","
","^А я только и видела, как он пьет.","
","ev","str","^glassTank","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_flats","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Торговцы, курьеры, возчики топлива, солдаты из Носа за водой, а еще молчуны всякие: спрашивают про <term=granary>Элеватор</term>, воды не берут.","
","^Вот кто про Элеватор спрашивает, те меня и тревожат. Странно у колодца про воду забыть.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_strangers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Водилы с пустыми кузовами расспрашивают, рейдеры им платят наше зерно считать.","
","^Одиль каждый вечер мелом на воротах Элеватора пишет, сколько там зерна. Так что платят они за умение читать.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_granary","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^За воду платят как гости, а командуют как хозяева.","
","^Просят вежливо. Потом стоят над душой, пока не сделаешь.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_soldiers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Не остановят. И тех, кто придет твой грузовик отбирать, тоже не остановят.","
","^Между городами дорогу никто не охраняет, а рейдеры Обжига обдирают любой грузовик, который не может отбиться и не платит.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_roads","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Впустить-то тебя впустят.","
","^И выпустят тоже, с пушкой или без. Только слыхала, что «Пирс» грузовик без пушки не страхует.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_unarmed","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Пим Арслан говорит, все волны на стекле клонятся в одну сторону, к кратеру <term=fallen_sun>Павшего солнца</term>.","
","^А я в полдень на это стекло ни ногой. И проверять, опасно ли, не собираюсь. <term=sunward>Обращенные к Солнцу</term> говорят, стекло кланяется тому, что в кратере.","
","ev","str","^talkGlassLean","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_glass","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^Водят в кратер, выводят зеленых по краям и тихих.","
","^Я в тот кратер не ходила и не пойду.","
","ev","str","^talkSunwardTake","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_sunward","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^Тихо, как в высохшем колодце. Двоюродный брат Бо говорит, в сумерках огни перестали ходить к кратеру. И к моему колодцу приходил человек с зеленым свечением на руках, спрашивал, где тут переночевать. Ну так двоюродный брат Бо много чего болтает. По тебе видно, что знаешь об этом побольше него.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^Одну видела, в сумерках. Руки у нее в темноте зеленым светились, а воду пила молча, ведро за ведром.","
","^Не заплатила ни М и пошла обратно к кратеру.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_came_out","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"towed_to_bowl"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Бывай, долг с доски сам не сотрется. ",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ Бывай, заходи за водой, когда будут М. И колеса по дороге не растеряй. ",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],"nop","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_rumor"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_flats"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_glass"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_sunward"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_strangers"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_granary"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_soldiers"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_roads"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_came_out"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_tow"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_strip"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_unarmed"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Jory Baptiste. I speak for the tenants, which is to say I talk and the <term=senate>Senate</term> nods off. Sit down, the stool's free. It's the only free thing in <term=bowl>Bowl</term>, so enjoy it.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are the tenants?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^How does a tenant get a vote?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_green"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do tenants take up the patrol?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_patrol"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Does the patrol trouble you?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_filled"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do the raiders have to do with the grain?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_filled"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why do the top terraces stay green?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_green"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of Nose?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_nose"},"str","^nose","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^We grow the food, and the citizens eat it. You can tell us apart by the dirt under the nails. We work the families' terraces and keep a share of what we grow. We've no vote in the Senate, so the families decide what we plant and what we're paid.","
","^The top terraces, where the old families live, stay green even in a dry year. Nobody's explained that to me, and I wouldn't dare ask. A miracle's a miracle.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_green","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_nose","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^He serves in the Bowl road patrol for a decade. Then the Senate lets him drop a pebble in a jar. My grandfather died one season short, which was bad timing, but he always kept his own schedule.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_patrol","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^They do, because the Senate wrote the rule and I read it back to them slowly. They said service earns a vote, so I send them the service. They let tenants carry rifles on the road and pay half the cost on grain runs, and nobody asked what a rifle in a tenant's hands might mean on voting day.","
","^The patrol knows my face by now. I've noticed the patrol and the raiders in the south get paid out of the same sacks, but that's a longer story. I've been told I'm a long story myself.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_filled","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^It does, and it knows where I live. They searched my house at night once and said they were looking for a rifle. They found a spoon, and I told them to keep it because I've got more.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Kiln Camp, the raiders in the south, gets a sack from the <term=granary>Granary</term> for every armed truck that crosses their road. The patrol is paid out of the tenants' share of the same grain.","
","^The sack leaves the store once and the Senate counts it twice. The Senate says it all adds up, and it does, the way a bucket with a hole adds up.","
","ev","str","^talkGranaryGate","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Because, if the word's right, the household's own tanker fills up at Dustwell every week and drives straight up to the top gardens. Its loads go in nobody's book. If you say so in the market, they'll ask for the book, so I say it only here.","
","^Have I seen the tanker unload? No. I've seen the kitchen gardens up there, and they're very green for a dry year. Either the tanker exists or those cabbages are saints.","
","ev","str","^talkSeepPipe","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They ration everyone and call it kindness. A fed man in a line is still a man in a line. Ask me again in a famine and I might change my mind, or I might not, because I'm a stubborn fellow when I'm hungry.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_patrol"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_filled"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_green"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_nose"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Джори Батист. Я говорю за арендаторов: я говорю, а <term=senate>Сенат</term> дремлет. Садись, табурет свободный. Другого бесплатного в <term=bowl>Чаше</term> не найдешь, так что пользуйся.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Кто такие арендаторы?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Как арендатор получает голос?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_green"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Арендаторы идут в патруль?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_patrol"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Патруль тебя не донимает?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_filled"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^При чем тут рейдеры и зерно?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_filled"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Почему верхние террасы зеленые?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_green"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что думаешь о Носе?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_nose"},"str","^nose","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Мы растим еду, а граждане её едят. Нас легко отличить: у нас земля под ногтями. Мы работаем на террасах семей и оставляем себе долю урожая. В Сенате у нас голоса нет. Поэтому семьи решают, что нам сажать и сколько нам платить.","
","^Верхние террасы, где живут старые семьи, зеленые даже в сухой год. Мне этого никто не объяснял. Спросить я не посмею. Чудо есть чудо.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_green","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_nose","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Десять лет он служит в дорожном патруле Чаши. Потом Сенат разрешает ему бросить камешек в банку. Мой дед не дослужил один сезон. Вышло некстати, но жил он всегда по своему расписанию.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_patrol","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Идут, потому что правило написал Сенат, а я просто прочитал его им вслух, не спеша. Они сказали, что служба дает голос. Вот я и посылаю им службу. Арендаторам разрешили носить винтовки на дороге и платят половину расходов на зерновых рейсах. Никто не спросил, что значит винтовка в руках арендатора в день голосования.","
","^Патруль уже знает меня в лицо. Я заметил, что патруль и рейдеры на юге получают плату из одних и тех же мешков. Но это долгая история. Меня самого, кстати, тоже называют долгой историей.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_filled","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Донимает. И знает, где я живу. Однажды ночью они обыскали мой дом. Сказали, что ищут винтовку. Нашли ложку. Я велел им оставить её себе, у меня есть ещё.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Рейдеры из лагеря Обжиг, что на юге, получают мешок с <term=granary>Элеватора</term> за каждый вооруженный грузовик, который проезжает по их дороге. Патруль получает плату из доли арендаторов, из того же зерна.","
","^Мешок уходит со склада один раз, а Сенат записывает его дважды. Сенат говорит, что всё сходится. Ну да, как в дырявом ведре: сколько налили, столько и ушло.","
","ev","str","^talkGranaryGate","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Потому что, если верить слухам, цистерна двора каждую неделю набирает воду у Пыльного колодца. И едет прямо к верхним садам. Эти рейсы не записаны ни в одной книге. Скажешь об этом на рынке, и с тебя спросят книгу. Поэтому я говорю только здесь.","
","^Видел ли я, как цистерна разгружается? Нет. Зато видел огороды наверху. Для сухого года они слишком зеленые. Либо цистерна существует, либо эти кочаны святые.","
","ev","str","^talkSeepPipe","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Они всех сажают на паек и называют это заботой. Сытый человек в очереди всё равно стоит в очереди. Спроси меня в голодный год, может, и передумаю. А может, и нет: я упрямый, когда голодный.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_patrol"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_filled"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_green"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_nose"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Sit a while, the shade is free. I am Ruben, and I keep the canal gates. That means I decide which fields drink first, so I'm used to being cursed by people who are only thirsty. What is on your mind?","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What is this place?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who runs Bowl?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where can I get water, or find work?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^What does Bowl make?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^What did your grandmother tell you about the old days?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_old"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What is the Fallen Sun?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_sun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What is the Fallen Sun really?","/str","str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you know about Dustwell?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_water"},"str","^dustwell","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^What are the tenants saying?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_senate"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^What came of the Pierce loan?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_senate"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Bowl is a farm built in terraces down the inside of a crater. The canals here still carry water, and water runs downhill, and so do people. Folk came for the canals and stayed for the seed.","
","^My grandmother kept these same gates before me. She liked to say that a town is only a field that learned to talk.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_old","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^The canal families do. Every gate has a family that tends it, and every family has a say in the Senate, the council of citizens that decides for all of Bowl. It is a slow way to decide anything, but nobody I know has starved waiting for a quick answer.","
","^The tenants who work the terraces for the families aren't citizens, so they have no seat. In the last drought, Pierce Corporation offered the Senate a long loan of grain, and the Senate argued over that loan for a whole season.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_senate","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Water is Hattie's trade. She keeps the well house and sells a bucket to anyone with M's. Work is Dag's, because he rides with the <term=farmers>Farmers</term> and knows what hauls are waiting.","
","^I only open the gates. The water that goes through them belongs to the families, and the water trucks bring it from <term=dustwell>Dustwell</term>. That's a well outpost up the north road, hours away. They pour it into the canals at the bottom of Bowl, and the families share it out.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_water","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Sorgut, mostly. Every barrel the trucks bring from <term=dustwell>Dustwell</term> goes through my gates to the terraces, and the terraces give it back three sacks for one.","
","^The weavers and the clinic need nothing from outside but patience. The machinists' benches eat scrap, and the workshop wants batteries from Nose for its radios. My grandmother called that buying thunder in a box.","
","ev","str","^water","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The canals are low this week. The terraces drink after the houses, so the sorgut comes in thin, and nobody thanks the man at the gate.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^scrap","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The machinists sit idle for want of scrap, and an idle machinist talks more than a dry canal.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.21"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^batteries","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The workshop is out of batteries, so the radios lie open on the benches like fish on a bank.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.30"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^She said the whole basin was orchards in her own grandmother's time, from wall to wall, and the canals ran full in every season. Then the sky fell and the fruit went with it. She never could agree with herself on which came first.","
","^What fell is what people call the Fallen Sun.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^People say it was a ship, bigger than all of Bowl. It came down burning and dug a crater out in the basin. Some say it brought the end of the world with it, but I say the end was already here. The ship only added one more bucket to a field that was flooded already.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^So you've stood in that crater, and you know more of it than I do. <term=nose>Nose</term> calls the ship a warship, and Hattie at the well house calls it a seed ship that lost its way. I can only tell you that nothing grows near it, and of any place that is the worst thing I know how to say.","
","ev",{"x()":"cult_broken"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Folk go out there after dark again, now the lamps have stopped crossing. ",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ Don't be out there after dark, either. The Sunward cross to it at dusk with their lamps, and I don't know a canal family that would follow them. ",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^In the last dry year the pumps at Green Pit drew mud by noon, and the Senate argued over whose fault that was, as if the pumps had been listening.","
","^In the Dustwell shed, Wendell Ondra kept the pump book all his life and died at the Green Pit sluice. His niece Agnes keeps the book now, and she writes down every drop.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^They say they feed Bowl and have no say in it, and they're right. The families never wanted to tell a tenant what to think, only what to plant.","
","^Jory Baptiste speaks for them on the terraces. He is quick, and I like him, and I vote against him anyway.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^The Senate turned it down. Pierce wanted the canal gates as surety. If a dry year came and we couldn't pay, Pierce would own the water, and the families would be tenants on their own terraces.","
","^My grandmother would have thrown the man in the canal. The Senate only argued with him for a season, which I suppose is how we throw people now.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_old"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_senate"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_water"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Посиди, тень бесплатная. Я Рубен, слежу за воротами канала. Это значит, что я решаю, какие поля пьют первыми. Потому я и привык, что меня клянут люди, которым просто хочется пить. Что у тебя на уме?","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Что это за место?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Кто заправляет в Чаше?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Где взять воду или найти работу?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Что дает Чаша?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Что твоя бабка рассказывала о старых днях?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_old"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что такое Павшее солнце?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_sun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что такое Павшее солнце на самом деле?","/str","str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что ты знаешь о Пыльном колодце?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_water"},"str","^dustwell","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что говорят арендаторы?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_senate"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Чем кончилось с займом «Пирса»?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_senate"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Чаша — это ферма, выстроенная террасами по внутренней стороне кратера. Каналы здесь ещё несут воду, а вода течет под уклон, и люди тоже. Пришли ради каналов, а остались ради семян.","
","^До меня эти самые ворота держала моя бабка. Любила повторять, что город — это поле, которое научилось говорить.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_old","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Семьи, что ходят за каналами. За каждыми воротами смотрит своя семья, и у каждой семьи есть голос в Сенате. Это совет граждан, он решает за всю Чашу. Так решать медленно, зато никто из моих знакомых не умер с голоду, дожидаясь быстрого ответа.","
","^Арендаторы, что работают на террасах у семей, не граждане, и места в Сенате у них нет. В последнюю засуху корпорация «Пирс» предложила Сенату долгий заем зерном, и Сенат спорил об этом займе целый сезон.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_senate","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Вода — дело Хэтти. Она держит колодезную и продает ведро любому, у кого есть М. Работа — дело Дага: он ездит с <term=farmers>патрулем Чаши</term> и знает, какие грузы ждут.","
","^Я только открываю ворота. Вода, что идет через них, принадлежит семьям. Её привозят грузовики от <term=dustwell>Пыльного колодца</term>. Это колодезный пост на северной дороге, до него несколько часов пути. Воду сливают в каналы на дне Чаши, а семьи делят её между собой.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_water","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^В основном соргут. Каждая бочка, которую грузовики привозят от <term=dustwell>Пыльного колодца</term>, идет через мои ворота на террасы, а террасы возвращают по три мешка за бочку.","
","^Ткачам и лечебнице со стороны ничего не нужно, кроме терпения. Верстаки механиков требуют лома, а мастерская ждет с Носа аккумуляторы для раций. Моя бабка называла это покупкой грома в коробке.","
","ev","str","^water","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Каналы на этой неделе обмелели. Террасы пьют после домов, так что соргут идет щуплый, и человеку у ворот спасибо никто не скажет.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^scrap","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Механики сидят без дела из-за нехватки лома, а праздный механик болтает больше, чем сухой канал.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.21"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^batteries","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^В мастерской кончились аккумуляторы, и рации лежат раскрытыми на верстаках, как рыба на берегу.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.30"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Говорила, что во времена её бабки вся котловина была в садах, от стены до стены, и каналы были полны в любое время года. Потом небо упало, а вместе с ним пропали и плоды. Что случилось раньше, она сама с собой так и не договорилась.","
","^То, что упало, люди зовут Павшим солнцем.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Люди говорят, это был корабль, больше всей Чаши. Он упал горящим и выбил в котловине кратер. Кто-то говорит, что он принес с собой конец света. А я говорю, конец уже был здесь. Корабль только вылил ещё одно ведро на залитое поле.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Значит, тебе довелось побывать в том кратере, и ты знаешь о нем больше моего. <term=nose>Нос</term> зовет корабль боевым, а Хэтти из колодезной зовет его кораблем с семенами, который сбился с пути. Мне известно одно: рядом с ним ничего не растет. Хуже этого я не могу сказать ни об одном месте.","
","ev",{"x()":"cult_broken"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Теперь, когда огни перестали ходить, люди снова выбираются туда после темноты. ",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ Ты после темноты там тоже не бывай. В сумерках Обращенные к Солнцу идут к нему со своими огнями, и я не знаю ни одной семьи с каналов, которая пошла бы за ними. ",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^В последний сухой год насосы Зеленой ямы к полудню качали грязь. А Сенат спорил, чья это вина, как будто насосы слушали.","
","^В сарае у Пыльного колодца Венделл Ондра всю жизнь вел насосную книгу и умер у шлюза Зеленой ямы. Теперь книгу ведет его племянница Агнес. Она записывает каждую каплю.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Говорят, что кормят Чашу, а голоса не имеют, и они правы. Семьи никогда не хотели говорить арендатору, что думать. Только что сажать.","
","^За них на террасах говорит Джори Батист. Он бойкий, и он мне нравится. Я всё равно голосую против него.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Сенат отказал. «Пирс» хотел взять в залог ворота каналов. Придет сухой год, мы не сможем расплатиться, и вода достанется «Пирсу». А семьи окажутся арендаторами на собственных террасах.","
","^Моя бабка бросила бы этого человека в канал. Сенат лишь спорил с ним целый сезон. Видно, так мы теперь людей и бросаем в канал.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_old"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_senate"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_water"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Just inside the gate is the yard: a lean-to of woven reeds, and under it an iron beam hanging from a post, with a flat pan at each end. A scavenger's truck stands at the beam, so you stop outside the gate and watch. ","#","^place: Bowl gate yard ","/#","#","^img: bowl_scale","/#","
","^The scavenger is a thin man in a coat patched with seat leather. He swings crates of bent rebar and rusted brackets onto one pan, one at a time. A woman with chalk to the wrists stacks iron weights on the other pan until the beam hangs level.","
","^She writes on a slate, counts M's into his palm and stacks his crates by the wall. He counts the M's again where he stands. Nobody out here trusts a count they didn't make. Then he drives out past you, his truck riding high on its springs.","
","^The woman wipes her hands on her apron and walks out through the gate to your truck. She looks into your bed before she looks at you. Fair enough. The crates are the interesting part. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Heavy bed. I'm Mags. Bring it to the beam and I'll weigh it, then I'll buy it. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
","^She raps a knuckle on your nearest crate and listens to the ring.","
","^That bent iron's good weight. It goes to the canal smiths for sluice hinges. The rains rust the old ones through every year. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
","^Engine guts weigh heavy. They go to whoever's truck is coughing. I don't ask whose truck they came off. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["ev","str","^What does the yard pay?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_pay"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Where do they find iron like that?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_where"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why would the Army leave it?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_where"},{"VAR?":"asked_army"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Leave her to her beam.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pay","re":true},"^By weight. The price is chalked on the board by the beam. Read it before you unload, and argue with the chalk, not with me. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
","^Each crate fetches a little less than the one before. The smiths can only use so much iron in a day. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
","^My price is Bowl's price. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
","^Nose pays more for iron, but it's a long climb for a few M's. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_where","re":true},"ev","str","^orchardIron","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Off dead trucks by the roads. A wreck near the gate is stripped bare in a day. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
","^The ones who come in heavy say Old Orchard, up the north road. Old barns, and Army sheds nobody's emptied. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
","^A Bowl patrol keeps the Orchard gate. It lets scavengers through. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_army","re":true},"^The <term=old_army>Old Army</term>? The cook fires at the Orchard went out one spring. Nobody lit them again. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
","^Why they left, I can't say. The old soldiers talk all night and never say. I weigh what they left. ","#","^speaker: Mags","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^She's back under the lean-to before you've turned around. Behind you, the next truck is already grinding up to the gate with its bed full.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_pay"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_where"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_army"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Сразу за воротами — двор: навес из плетеного тростника, а под ним на столбе висит железное коромысло с плоскими чашами по краям. У весов стоит грузовик мусорщика, так что вы останавливаетесь перед воротами и смотрите. ","#","^place: Двор у ворот Чаши ","/#","#","^img: bowl_scale","/#","
","^Мусорщик — тощий мужик в куртке, залатанной кожей с сидений. Он перетаскивает на одну из чаш ящики с гнутой арматурой и ржавыми кронштейнами, один за другим. Женщина с белыми от мела запястьями складывает на другую чашу железные гири, пока коромысло не встает ровно.","
","^Она пишет на грифельной доске, отсчитывает ему в ладонь М и складывает ящики у стены. Тот пересчитывает М не сходя с места. Здесь никто не верит чужому счету. Потом он выезжает со двора мимо вас: грузовик высоко поднялся на рессорах.","
","^Женщина вытирает руки о передник и выходит через ворота к вашему грузовику. Сначала она заглядывает в кузов и только потом смотрит на вас. И то верно: ящики куда интереснее. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Мэгс Коррин. Я на этом дворе весовщица, беру всё, что стоит класть на весы. Послушаем, что везешь. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
","^Она стучит костяшкой по ближайшему ящику и прислушивается к звуку — так покупатель на рынке проверяет спелую дыню.","
","^Гнутое железо идет кузнецам на каналы. В дожди петли на шлюзах каждый год ржавеют насквозь, и каждую новую петлю куют из лома с моих весов. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
","^Потроха мотора уходят тому, чей грузовик чихает. А с чьего грузовика всё это сняли, я не спрашиваю. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["ev","str","^Сколько платит двор?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_pay"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Где находят такое железо?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_where"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^С чего бы Армии всё это бросать?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_where"},{"VAR?":"asked_army"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Дать ей вернуться к весам.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pay","re":true},"^По весу, а не по россказням. Сегодняшняя цена выведена мелом на доске у весов. Глянь на доску, прежде чем разгружаться. И спорь с мелом, а не со мной. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
","^Кузнецам много железа в день не надо, так что каждый следующий ящик идет дешевле прежнего. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
","^Моя цена — цена Чаши. Наверху на Носу полно станков и нет полей, там за железо платят больше. Только долго подниматься в гору ради пары М. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_where","re":true},"ev","str","^orchardIron","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^С брошенных грузовиков вдоль дорог, пока их не разобрал другой водитель. Обломки так близко к воротам растаскивают за день. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
","^Те, кто приезжает с тяжелым грузом, говорят про Старый сад выше по северной дороге. Старые амбары и армейские сараи, которые никто так и не вычистил. У ворот Сада стоит патруль Чаши, и патруль пропускает мусорщиков. Никто там не стреляет в водителя из-за лома. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_army","re":true},"^<term=old_army>Старая армия</term>? Одной весной в Саду остыли полевые кухни, и никто их больше не растапливал. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
","^Почему ушла — спроси старых солдат. Будут говорить всю ночь и так ничего и не скажут. Я взвешиваю то, что они оставили, а на моих весах оно весит одинаково, почему бы они ни ушли. ","#","^speaker: Мэгс","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Вы ещё не успеваете отвернуться, а она уже снова под навесом. Позади вас со скрежетом ползет к воротам следующий грузовик с полным кузовом.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_pay"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_where"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_army"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^"It's not about the truck, it's about the driver. Geezer is straight edge. If you knew who he rode with..." ","#","^speaker: Tibor ","/#","#","^place: The southern outpost ","/#","#","^img: road_table","/#","
","^Tibor cuts himself short when he sees your eyes.","
","^The three of you have been at this table for a while. Tibor is trying to sell your services, the woman is doubting your competence, and you sit trying to figure it out. With your back to the wall. Force of habit.","
","^Escort a mammoth eighteen-wheeler up the great Northern highway, don't ask where, don't ask what's inside. Good pay. Sounds like a routine job, but you have sat at enough tables to know it's anything but.","
","^Tibor smiles at you. His eyes are welcoming, but, as always, a little watery and darting in your presence. Like a ferret's. You saw a ferret in a book, once. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Her name is Ala. ","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^The great mammoth eighteen-wheeler and the tiny woman that drives it attracted the attention of the whole <term=keepers>Keepers</term> fort as soon as they arrived.","
","^She is small, but there is a ferocity to her eyes and the constant slight frown above them that give away an experienced <term=link>linked</term> driver. Otherwise, you guess, she wouldn't be driving a truck like that. Still, you already figured: experienced hauler. Maybe a trader. Not a fighter.","
","^She looks at you and you see doubt.","
","^"Are you sure you are up for the job, old man? With that truck?" ","#","^speaker: Ala ","/#","#","^page","/#","
","^She has a point. ","#","^img: road_geezer","/#","
","^She sees a man past fifty, stuck in a shithole fort on the outskirts, driving a barely armed light pick-up truck. She can't know that just two weeks ago you drove one beautiful monster of a truck. Now it is nothing but a black patch beside a crater. All it takes is one unlucky landmine. As if there is such a thing as a lucky landmine.","
","^Having barely survived the explosion, you were brutally ripped off on this scout truck. Not the worst outcome, all things considered. But you need a job and you need to get out of this place.","
","^"You need protection up the highway and I can offer it. Since we are talking at all, something tells me you are out of options. There is no one else reliable in this bar. But I get it done." ","#","^page ","/#","#","^speaker: You","/#","
","^She is about to speak, but you interrupt.","
","^"Whether you decide to take me up or not, that's alright. But remember the fools you talked to yesterday? They are already hard at work. Laying an ambush for you. They think you are easy pickings." ","#","^speaker: You","/#","
","^Tibor looks at the ceiling.","
","^Ala looks at you for a long time. Then something changes in her eyes. She can finally see. What most people see around you. What makes Tibor dart his eyes like a ferret.","
","^And then you shake hands and it is agreed. ","#","^img: road_hauler ","/#","#","^page","/#","
","^Get the trailer and Ala in one piece to the next Keepers fort. Don't ask what is inside the truck and don't ask where it is going. Some M's in advance, more pay by the stretch of the highway, and a big, sweet payout at the end.","
","^Sounds like a routine job, but you have seen enough to know better.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_hired","re":true},"end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^«Дело не в грузовике, а в водителе. Старик не пьет, не дурит. Знала бы ты, с кем он раньше ездил...» ","#","^speaker: Тибор ","/#","#","^place: Южный пост ","/#","#","^img: road_table","/#","
","^Тибор ловит ваш взгляд и осекается.","
","^Вы втроем уже давно сидите за этим столом. Тибор пытается продать ваши услуги, женщина сомневается, есть ли от вас толк, а вы пытаетесь понять, во что ввязываетесь. Сидите спиной к стене. Привычка.","
","^Сопроводить громадный грузовик на восемнадцати колесах по великому Северному шоссе. Не спрашивать, куда он направляется и что везет. Платят хорошо. На словах работа как работа. Но опыт подсказывает: всё далеко не так просто.","
","^Тибор вам улыбается. Смотрит приветливо, но глаза чуть слезятся, а взгляд то и дело ускользает в сторону. Рядом с вами он всегда такой. Напоминает хорька. Когда-то вам попалась книга с картинкой хорька. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Её зовут Ала. ","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^Громадный восемнадцатиколесный грузовик и крохотная женщина за рулем привлекли внимание всего форта <term=keepers>Хранителей</term>, едва появились у ворот.","
","^Маленькая, черноволосая. Волосы обрезаны коротко и неровно, будто она сама орудовала ножом. Свирепый взгляд и вечно чуть нахмуренные брови выдают опытную водительницу в <term=link>сцепке</term>. Иначе, думаете вы, она бы не водила такую громадину. Впрочем, вы уже понимаете, кто перед вами. Бывалая дальнобойщица. Может, торговка. Не боец.","
","^Она смотрит на вас с сомнением.","
","^«Точно потянешь, старик? На таком грузовике?» ","#","^speaker: Ала ","/#","#","^page","/#","
","^Её можно понять. ","#","^img: road_geezer","/#","
","^Перед ней мужик за пятьдесят, застрявший в засранном форте на отшибе. Из техники у него легкий пикап почти без оружия. Ей невдомек, что всего две недели назад под вами был роскошный грузовик. Настоящее чудовище. Теперь от него осталось черное пятно у воронки. Просто не повезло с одной миной. Будто с миной вообще может повезти.","
","^Вы едва пережили взрыв, а потом за этот разведывательный грузовик с вас содрали втридорога. Если подумать, могло быть и хуже. Но вам нужна работа, и пора выбираться отсюда. ","#","^page","/#","
","^«На шоссе тебе нужна охрана. Я тебя прикрою. Раз мы вообще разговариваем, похоже, выбирать тебе не из кого. Больше ни на кого в этом баре положиться нельзя. А я свое дело сделаю». ","#","^speaker: Вы","/#","
","^Она собирается что-то сказать, но вы ее перебиваете.","
","^«Наймешь ты меня или нет, дело твое. Но помнишь придурков, с которыми ты вчера говорила? Они уже вовсю работают. Готовят тебе засаду. Думают, с тобой легко справятся». ","#","^speaker: Вы","/#","
","^Тибор смотрит в потолок.","
","^Ала долго смотрит на вас. Потом что-то меняется в ее глазах. Наконец и до нее доходит то, что большинство понимает при встрече с вами. Почему у Тибора так бегают глаза, словно у хорька.","
","^Вы скрепляете уговор рукопожатием. ","#","^img: road_hauler ","/#","#","^page","/#","
","^Довести Алу и прицеп целыми до следующего форта Хранителей. Не спрашивать, что везет грузовик и куда он направляется. Небольшой аванс в М, плата за каждый участок шоссе, а в конце пути заплатят щедро.","
","^На словах работа как работа. Но опыт подсказывает: всё далеко не так просто.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_hired","re":true},"end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^You are parked in the breach of the Fallen Sun, where the ship's reactor still burns. Its green light fills the windshield, and you stayed in it. ","#","^place: The reactor of the Fallen Sun","/#","
","ev",{"x()":"offered_tonight"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You gave the riders of the order your word tonight, and you kept it to the end.",{"->":"start.12"},null]}],"nop","
","^It isn't even hot. The light comes through the glass, through the cab and through the inside of your eyelids, and closing them changes nothing.","
","^Through the link the truck feels whole: steel, rubber and diesel at the edge of everything. It's you that's wrong. Your hands have gone soft and far away, and there's iron in your mouth. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The link has always known where you end. A row of contacts down your spine, a plug at the base of your skull, two clamps at your neck, and the truck on the other side of them, sure of who sits in its seat.","
","^Now it starts to lose you. Its sense of you flickers, the way a radio drifts off a station. It reaches for the hands on the wheel and finds them, and then it doesn't. It reaches for the breath in the seat and finds less of it every time.","
","^Somewhere in the back of your head a sense you never had a name for goes quiet. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The light burned you from the inside while you sat in it. You are dead.","
","^The truck waits in the breach with the engine idling, but nobody comes back into the link. There is only a body in the seat. ","#","^reveal: word","/#","
","^The engine idles until the tank runs dry.","
","end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Вы стоите в проломе Павшего солнца, где всё ещё горит реактор корабля. Зеленый свет заливает лобовое стекло, и вы остаетесь в нем. ","#","^place: Реактор Павшего солнца","/#","
","ev",{"x()":"offered_tonight"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Сегодня ночью вы дали всадникам ордена слово и сдержали его до конца.",{"->":"start.12"},null]}],"nop","
","^Здесь даже не горячо. Свет проходит сквозь стекло, сквозь кабину и сквозь веки, и если закрыть глаза, ничего не меняется.","
","^Через сцепку грузовик чувствуется целым: сталь, резина и солярка на краю всего сущего. Дело в вас. Руки стали ватными и далекими, а во рту — привкус железа. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Сцепка всегда знала, где кончаетесь вы. Ряд контактов вдоль позвоночника, разъем у основания черепа, два зажима на шее, а по ту сторону — грузовик, который точно знает, кто сидит в его кресле.","
","^Теперь она начинает вас терять. Ощущение человека меркнет, как уходящая волна радиоприемника. Сцепка тянется к рукам на руле, находит их — и тут же теряет. Тянется к дыханию в кресле, но с каждым разом находит всё меньше.","
","^Где-то в глубине затылка угасает чувство, для которого у вас никогда не было названия. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Свет сжег вас изнутри, пока вы сидели в нем. Вы мертвы.","
","^Грузовик ждет в проломе на холостом ходу, но в сцепку никто не возвращается. В кресле осталось только тело. ","#","^reveal: word","/#","
","^Мотор работает на холостых, пока бак не опустеет.","
","end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The truck stops dead. Through the link you feel every part of it jolt at once, and your forehead meets the wheel with a sound you feel in your teeth. ","#","^place: The cab ","/#","#","^img: fall_cab","/#","
","^Something warm runs into your left eye. A thin high whine fills your ears, and under it the engine ticks as it cools. So that's what losing sounds like.","
","^Your sleeve comes away dark and wet. You blink until the steel slats across the windshield stop sliding sideways.","
","^Out past the hood, where the dust is settling, the other truck has stopped side on. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Its gun is still pointed your way, and a thin grey thread of smoke climbs from the barrel. Nobody stands at the gun. Behind the dusty side window of the cab, a figure in goggles sits and watches you.","
","^You tell your hands to do something. They stay in your lap, heavy as sacks. So you wait for the shot, and you find you're too tired to mind much.","
","^The shot doesn't come. ","#","^page","/#","
","^When you look again, the barrel has swung up and away on the whine of its motor. The driver pushes the goggles up, spits out of the window and climbs down.","
","^They walk to your truck slow, with a rifle slung across their back, and they don't even glance at the cab as they pass. Why would they? You're not going anywhere. The bed creaks under their weight. For a while you listen to them go through everything you own, unhurried, like somebody doing chores.","
