","^Тогда скоро тебе понадобится наладчик. Все сиденья на дорогах старше нас с тобой, а старые воротники натирают. Приходи, пока шею не стерло до мяса, а не после.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"edda_answered","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Значит, новичок. Первый раз почти всех валит с ног, а потом весь день трясет. Через неделю езды тело перестает сопротивляться.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"edda_answered","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Новичок через месяц уже приезжает чинить сиденье. Воротники натирают, контакты разбалтываются, кабели трескаются. Хочу, чтобы чиниться приезжали ко мне.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"edda_answered","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Больше всех на этой горе. Сиденье соединяет твои нервы с грузовиком, это тебе и так известно. А вот чего ты не знаешь: контакты сейчас никто делать не умеет. Это выступы на спинке, вдоль всего позвоночника до затылка.","
","^Они остались от <term=chaos>Хаоса</term>, и мы только перепаиваем те, что ещё работают. Умрут последние контакты в сиденье, и грузовик снова станет просто грузовиком.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"edda_heard_links","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Дед, по его словам, застал, как всё начиналось. Во времена Хаоса после войн оставалось столько солдат без рук и ног, что их никто не мог сосчитать. В мастерских делали искусственные руки и подключали их к нервам солдата. Деду достались две.","
","^Потом кто-то подключил нервы солдата не к руке, а к танку. Солдат чувствовал весь танк и управлял им, как собственным телом. Дед говорил, тот почти забыл, где кончается он сам и начинается танк.","
","^Зато один солдат теперь делал работу целого экипажа. После этого сцепки понадобились всем армиям, и к простым танкам уже никто не вернулся.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"edda_asked_origin","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Не так, как первый солдат в сцепке. Он неделями жил в своем танке и не вылезал. А ты каждый вечер вылезаешь и спишь в кровати. С водителями беда попроще. Старым мехам без сиденья как будто половины себя не хватает, вот они и стараются из него не вылезать.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"edda_asked_lose","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Чинил сиденья до самой смерти, теми же двумя руками. Он меня и научил.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"edda_asked_grandfather","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Разъем оставляет кольцо у основания черепа, а зажимы — по следу с каждой стороны шеи. Поначалу следы проходят. Через год езды в сцепке останутся насовсем. По ним старого меха и узнают.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"edda_asked_marks","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Ну, давай. В следующий раз покажи шею, посмотрю, сошел ли след.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"edda_answered"},false,{"VAR=":"edda_heard_links"},false,{"VAR=":"edda_asked_origin"},false,{"VAR=":"edda_asked_lose"},false,{"VAR=":"edda_asked_grandfather"},false,{"VAR=":"edda_asked_marks"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Eh? Pull up a crate. I'm Ibo. I listen to the air for the Army, and to everything else for myself.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What do you do in this shack?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What was the Old World like?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_oldworld"},{"VAR?":"asked_oldworld"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the Bowl folk?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_bowl"},{"VAR?":"asked_bowl"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Heard anything interesting on the air?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where does Jill Jane broadcast from?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_jj"},{"VAR?":"asked_jj"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What does the tone from the Fallen Sun say?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tone"},{"VAR?":"asked_tone"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Hear anything from the crater at night?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tone"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who are the Guild couriers?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_couriers"},{"VAR?":"asked_couriers"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^What happened at Burnt Convoy?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_convoy"},"str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_convoy"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^How did the Old Army end?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_army"},{"VAR?":"asked_army"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who pays for the Old Orchard tools?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tools"},{"VAR?":"asked_tools"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^Heard about the depot business?","/str",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^open","/str","!=","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-12","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Freeze, mostly, and listen. The Army pays me for its own calls, and whatever else drifts through I keep for myself. There's Jill Jane, who runs Waste Of Time Radio and comes in best after dark. There's the couriers of the <term=guild>Guild</term> calling their rounds. And now and then there's a tone out of the <term=fallen_sun>Fallen Sun</term>, the big crashed hull in the crater, that nobody can explain. The set itself is <term=old_world>Old World</term> work, built back when there were masts on every hill.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_oldworld","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_jj","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_couriers","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_tone","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Bigger than anyone here thinks. Bowl folk will tell you it was all orchards, and that's rubbish. There were highways, power lines, towns bigger than Nose and Bowl put together. The orchards were only what you could see from the canals. I knew men of the <term=old_army>Old Army</term> who could drive a mountain road blind, and there's nobody like them left.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_oldworld","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Good people, slow talkers. They'd hold a meeting to decide whether to hold a meeting. Still, their grain keeps us fed, so the Army minds its manners with them.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Scavengers gab about the Burnt Convoy now and then, that row of burnt trucks the road crews hauled off. Picked clean, they say. The stretch is all ash and bent rims, and not worth the fuel to go and look.","
","ev","str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Nobody knows, but I'd wager she moves it. Her signal's strongest at night, and it drifts like the mast is on wheels. Don't tell the Sergeant I listen to her. He thinks this shack is for the Army alone.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_jj","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^It's a low, steady note that comes and goes, always from the crater's side. Some say it counts the years since the fall. I've no key to decode it, and the Army never asked me to log it. If it counts, it counts without me.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tone","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","ev",{"x()":"cult_broken"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Eh? Quieter than it's been in years. A line of lamps used to cross to the crater every dusk, and if you called them you got an open channel and somebody breathing on it. Now there's nothing at all. I'd wager somebody finally stopped them. Do not tell the Sergeant I was glad.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Eh? Nobody out there talks, that's the odd part. Every dusk a line of lamps goes out to the crater, and if you call them you get an open channel and somebody breathing on it, nothing more. Joss Ardo, who sings with the Children of Noah now, rode with them once and got out. I'd wager he's the only one who ever did.","
","ev","str","^sunwardLamps","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^They carry the mail between the towns. They run in pairs now, two trucks together. I remember when they went out alone, before the Kiln riders got bold. Kiln's the raider camp in the south. Tamsin Roe's the odd one, with no gun at all. I hear her call-sign more than any other.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_couriers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^A whole convoy went up in one night, years back. Some say raiders did it. Some say a fuel truck blew and took the rest with it. I heard the last calls on the air, and nobody said who started it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Hungry. Commander Lind nailed a book of every unpaid promise to the gate at Old Orchard, the Army's depot, and then he died in the motor pool. I heard his last calls on the air. He read the whole list. The machine tools stayed behind in the shed, and somebody's still paying for those.","
","^Some say the Army didn't run out of food. They say it was starved on purpose. I say a man who starts a rumor like that wants a seat in the hall.","
","ev","str","^talkArmyStarved","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^The Guild's trust owns them and rents them to us. Command pays the Guild, and the Guild hears who pays command. I hear the Guild on the air, a little. I won't repeat it.","
","ev","str","^talkCommitteeRent","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^vance","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Vance! He sat at my table on cold nights, and I'd have trusted him with my radio.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^pell","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Pell? That man can't steal a biscuit without saying sorry to it. Somebody else is laughing tonight.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^bought","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The depot's clean, they say. Funny, then, that the trader by the gate still sells fuel cheap.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Fuel still goes missing, they say. It's not my business, and it's not yours either, now.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_oldworld"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_oldworld"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_bowl"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_bowl"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_jj"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_jj"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_tone"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_tone"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_couriers"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_couriers"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_convoy"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_convoy"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_army"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_army"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_tools"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_tools"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^А? Садись на ящик. Я Ибо. Эфир я слушаю для Армии, а всё остальное для себя.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Чем ты тут в будке занят?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Каким был старый мир?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_oldworld"},{"VAR?":"asked_oldworld"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что скажешь о чашниках?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_bowl"},{"VAR?":"asked_bowl"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что интересного слышно в эфире?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Откуда вещает Джилл Джейн?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_jj"},{"VAR?":"asked_jj"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что говорит тон из Павшего солнца?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tone"},{"VAR?":"asked_tone"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Слышно что-нибудь из кратера ночью?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tone"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Кто такие курьеры Гильдии?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_couriers"},{"VAR?":"asked_couriers"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что случилось на Сгоревшем конвое?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_convoy"},"str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_convoy"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Как кончилась Старая армия?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_army"},{"VAR?":"asked_army"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Кто платит за станки Старого сада?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tools"},{"VAR?":"asked_tools"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что слышно про дела на складе?","/str",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^open","/str","!=","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":5},"ev","str","^До свидания.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-12","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^В основном мерзну и слушаю. Армия платит мне за свои переговоры, а всё остальное, что приплывет, я оставляю себе. Есть Джилл Джейн, у нее «Радио Трата времени», лучше всего ловится после темноты. Есть курьеры <term=guild>Гильдии</term>, они выходят на связь по своему маршруту. А иногда из <term=fallen_sun>Павшего солнца</term>, того большого разбитого корпуса в кратере, идет тон, и никто не может его объяснить. Сам приемник работы <term=old_world>старого мира</term>, ещё с тех пор, когда мачты стояли на каждом холме.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_oldworld","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_jj","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_couriers","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_tone","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Больше, чем тут думают. Чашники скажут, что там были одни сады, и это чепуха. Были шоссе, линии электропередачи, города больше, чем Нос и Чаша вместе. А сады — просто то, что видно с каналов. Я знал людей из <term=old_army>Старой армии</term>, которые могли вести машину по горной дороге вслепую. Таких больше не осталось.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_oldworld","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Люди хорошие, говорят медленно. Соберут сход решать, собирать ли сход. Зато их зерно нас кормит, так что Армия с ними ведет себя вежливо.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Мусорщики иногда болтают про Сгоревший конвой. Это ряд обгорелых грузовиков, которые дорожные бригады оттащили в сторону. Говорят, там всё обчистили до нитки. Одна зола да гнутые диски. Ради этого топливо жечь не стоит.","
","ev","str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Никто не знает, но я бы поспорил, что она возит станцию с собой. Сигнал сильнее всего ночью и плывет, будто мачта на колесах. Сержанту не говори, что я её слушаю. Он думает, что эта будка только для Армии.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_jj","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Это низкий ровный звук, то появится, то пропадет, и всё время со стороны кратера. Одни говорят, что он считает годы с падения. Никакого ключа для шифра у меня нет, а Армия записывать его никогда не просила. Если он считает, то считает без меня.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tone","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","ev",{"x()":"cult_broken"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^А? Так тихо не было уже много лет. Раньше каждые сумерки к кратеру шла цепочка огней, и если их вызвать, открывался канал, а в нем кто-то дышит. Теперь вообще ничего. Я бы поспорил, что кто-то наконец их остановил. Сержанту не говори, что я обрадовался.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^А? Там никто не разговаривает, вот что странно. Каждые сумерки к кратеру идет цепочка огней, и если их вызвать, открывается канал, а в нем кто-то дышит, и больше ничего. Джосс Ардо, который теперь поет с Детьми Ноя, однажды ездил с ними и выбрался. Я бы поспорил, что только он один и выбрался.","
","ev","str","^sunwardLamps","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Возят почту между городами. Теперь ездят парами, по два грузовика. Помню, как они ездили поодиночке, пока рейдеры Обжига не обнаглели. Обжиг — это лагерь рейдеров на юге. Тэмсин Роу тут особая: у нее вообще нет оружия. Её позывной я слышу чаще всех.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_couriers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Целый конвой сгорел за одну ночь, много лет назад. Одни говорят, что рейдеры. Другие говорят, что рванул грузовик с топливом и утащил за собой остальные. Последние вызовы я слышал в эфире. Кто начал, никто так и не сказал.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Голодом. Командир Линд прибил к воротам Старого сада, армейского склада, книгу всех невыполненных обещаний. Потом умер в автопарке. Его последние вызовы я слышал в эфире. Он прочел весь список. Станки остались в сарае, и за них до сих пор кто-то платит.","
","^Одни говорят, что у Армии не кончилась еда. Что её заморили нарочно. А я так скажу: кто пускает такие слухи, тот метит на место в зале.","
","ev","str","^talkArmyStarved","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^Станками владеет трастовый фонд Гильдии, он их нам и сдает. Командование платит Гильдии, а Гильдия знает, кто платит командованию. Гильдию я немного слышу в эфире. Пересказывать не стану.","
","ev","str","^talkCommitteeRent","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^vance","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Вэнс! Сидел за моим столом холодными ночами, и я бы доверил ему приемник.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^pell","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Пелл? Этот и сухарь не украдет, не извинившись перед ним. Сегодня ночью смеется кто-то другой.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^bought","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Говорят, на складе чисто. Смешно, что торговка у ворот всё равно продает топливо дешево.","

","^Nose. The dispatch desk is mine. Freight on the north-east road or through the canyon crossing passes this desk, or it doesn't pass. If you want something to be proud of, ask the <term=committee>Committee</term> about the workshop line. It builds whole engines and guns. Bowl can't.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^On paper the Central Committee. In the street the Army. Command gives me orders, I hand them down, nobody argues. I hear <term=bowl>Bowl</term> votes on everything. I wouldn't last a morning there.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Bad once you're past the walls. Nobody keeps the road between our wall and Bowl's. Kiln riders, the raiders from the camp in the south, strip any truck that won't pay or fight. I log every truck out and every truck in. The ones that don't come back are the part I like least. Most of them went out without a gun. I don't stop them at the gate. I log them. One courier goes without. I haven't decided what I think of her.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_mounts","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Salt off the pans under the wall. Tools from the forge. Batteries from the cell shop.","
","^The forge burns scrap and diesel. The cell shop burns parts and diesel. The scrap and the parts come from the <term=salvage_yard>Yard</term>, the diesel from the Pump Station. Short of any of it, the line stops.","
","ev","str","^scrap","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Scrap's short. The forge is cold until the Yard trucks come in. I log it.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^fuelDrums","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Diesel's short. The forge and the cells both wait on the convoys. I log that too.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.21"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^parts","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Parts are short. The cell shop stands idle, and command asks me why.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.30"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["

","^Him. He sold us our own radio back, and I paid stock price for it. That set came off wagon Seven. She ran water drums from Dustwell to Bowl every week, and she went dark on the bend in the Bowl north road. The crew walked in and reported raiders, and her cannon lost over the edge. Command wrote her off. I log it.","
","^The scavenger said for a little more that the cannon's still on her. I didn't pay a little more.","
","ev","str","^wagonNose","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Written off by order, so whatever's left on her is yours. Don't make a habit of picking over Army property.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str","!=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You've got something in your hand you keep turning over. Don't show it to me. Show it to Lena at the bench. I log what I see there.","

","^Teller drives the water cart now. His stripes are in my drawer. Two depot trucks with the same cheap brake rods are off the road until Lena has looked at them. Command hasn't answered. I log that too.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^The raid report and the brake rod share a page, and command reads the top of it. Two depot trucks with the same cheap brake rods are off the road until Lena has looked at them. That's as far as my sheet goes.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^Corporal Teller came back from the wash pit with wet hands and a light purse. I don't log what I don't see, and I didn't see anything.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^Soldiers buy water at Bowl, and Bowl talks over the cups. Now my men come back up the road asking whether their own brakes will hold. You told Bowl before you told my log. I won't forget the order you did it in.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^A piece of Army steel from wagon Seven changed hands at the <term=salvage_yard>Yard</term>. I logged the sale. Your name is on the line, beside the price.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["
","^Old Orchard, the Old Army's depot. The machine tools are the Guild's, and command rents them. Who pays that rent is above my sheet.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-14":["
","^The gate isn't mine to shut on a driver. The line hands a steel mount to any driver who asks, so nobody can tell me he had nowhere to bolt a gun. What goes on it is between the driver and <term=pierce>Pierce</term>. Pierce writes his paper. I don't ask.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_mounts","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-15":["
","^Tamsin Roe, of the Guild. The Guild carries the mail between the towns. She drives with no gun of her own. The courier who runs with her carries the rifle. The two of them sign out at my gate like any truck, but I don't like what it teaches the other drivers. Brave or stupid, I haven't decided.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-16":["
","^It's the insurance that pays a driver when his truck is shot. Pierce writes it for any truck with a gun on it, and for no other. That's why the line hands out mounts.","

","^Нос. Диспетчерская здесь моя. Груз по северо-восточной дороге и через переправу в каньоне идет через этот стол. Или не идет совсем. Хочешь знать, чем мы тут гордимся, спроси <term=committee>Комитет</term> про мастерскую. Там целиком собирают двигатели и делают пушки. Чаше такое не под силу.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^На бумаге Центральный комитет. На деле армия. Командование отдает мне приказы, я передаю их ниже, и никто не спорит. Слышал, <term=bowl>Чаша</term> голосует по любому поводу. Я бы там и утра не продержался.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Плохая, как только выедешь за стены. Дорогу между нашей стеной и стеной Чаши никто не охраняет. Рейдеры Обжига, из южного лагеря, раздевают любой грузовик, который не платит и не дерется. Я записываю каждый грузовик на выезде и на въезде. Хуже всего те, что не возвращаются. Большинство из них уехали без пушки. У ворот я их не останавливаю. Записываю. Одна курьерша ездит без пушки. Что о ней думать, я ещё не решил.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_mounts","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Соль с соляных ванн под стеной. Станки из кузни. Аккумуляторы из аккумуляторного цеха.","
","^Кузня сжигает лом и солярку. Аккумуляторный цех жжет запчасти и солярку. Лом и запчасти идут со <term=salvage_yard>Свалки</term>, солярка — с Насосной станции. Если чего-то не хватает, линия встает.","
","ev","str","^scrap","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["

",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],"nop","

","^Списан приказом, так что всё, что на нем осталось, твое. Только не вздумай входить во вкус и растаскивать армейское имущество.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str","!=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Ты что-то вертишь в руке. Мне не показывай. Покажи Лене на верстаке. Что увижу там, то и запишу.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^wagonFound","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^admitted","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Теллер теперь водит водовозку. Нашивки у меня в ящике. Два складских грузовика с такими же дешевыми тормозными тягами сняты с рейсов, пока их не осмотрит Лена. Командование не ответило. Это я тоже записываю.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Рапорт о налете и тормозная тяга записаны на одной странице, а командование читает только верх. Два складских грузовика с такими же дешевыми тормозными тягами сняты с рейсов, пока их не осмотрит Лена. Дальше моих записей дело не идет.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^Капрал Теллер вернулся с мойки с мокрыми руками и с легким кошелем. Чего я не вижу, того не записываю. А я ничего не видел.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^Солдаты покупают воду в Чаше, а Чаша болтает над кружками. Теперь мои люди едут обратно и спрашивают, выдержат ли их тормоза. Чаша узнала от тебя раньше, чем мой журнал. Этот порядок я запомню.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^Кусок армейской стали с фургона «Седьмой» продали на <term=salvage_yard>Свалке</term>. Продажу я записал. Твое имя стоит в строке, рядом с ценой.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["
","^Старый сад, склад Старой армии. Станки принадлежат Гильдии, командование их арендует. Кто платит аренду, это выше моего чина.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-14":["
","^Не мне закрывать ворота перед водителем. В мастерской каждому, кто попросит, выдают стальное крепление, так что никто не скажет мне, будто пушку ставить некуда. Что на нем будет, решают водитель и <term=pierce>«Пирс»</term>. «Пирс» пишет свою бумагу. Я не спрашиваю.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_mounts","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-15":["
","^Тэмсин Роу, из Гильдии. Гильдия возит почту между городами. Своей пушки у нее нет. Винтовку носит курьер, который ездит с ней. Вдвоем они отмечаются на моих воротах, как любой грузовик, но мне не нравится, чему это учит других водителей. Храбрость это или глупость, я ещё не решил.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-16":["
","^Это страховка. Она платит водителю, если по его грузовику стреляли. «Пирс» страхует любой грузовик с пушкой. Без пушки не страхует. Поэтому в мастерской и выдают крепления.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-17":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_workshop"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_workshop"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_mounts"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_mounts"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_courier"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_courier"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_paper"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_paper"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^buried","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^You. Teller drinks better this week. Put it on the bench or don't, I've got work.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^logged","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^You again. The page is still in Kovac's log. Command hasn't read it. If it's broken, put it on the bench.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^admitted","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^You again. Teller signed it himself, and two trucks are off the line. Nobody asked me, but that's new. Put it on the bench.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Lena. If it's broken, put it on the bench. If it's talk, make it quick. My hands are busy.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What do you do here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Any advice for my truck?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where do I find cheap parts?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where can I get clean water?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why check brake rods before guns?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_swivel"},{"VAR?":"asked_rods"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do you trust Brann's mounts?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_brann"},{"VAR?":"asked_brann"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the Kiln riders?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kiln"},{"VAR?":"asked_kiln"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you know about the Fallen Sun?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_sun"},"str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_sun"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Anything for the glare at the Fallen Sun?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_glare"},{"VAR?":"asked_glare"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^I brought something from wagon Seven.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^I keep the Army's trucks running. Anybody else's too, if they bring them to my bench. Engines, plate, mounts, whatever breaks. I can tell what's wrong with a truck by the sound of it pulling in.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Every part does one job and fails at another. Heavy plate stops rounds, but it eats your speed. A big gun eats your deck on top of that. So buy what the road needs, not what shines on the shelf. And before you look at your guns, look at your brake rods.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_swivel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^The Salvage Yard, a way west of here. The crews strip whatever gets towed in, so parts go for next to nothing. You'll have to put up with the smell of burnt oil. For real plate you want the Fallen Sun, the big hull in the crater. I say that through my teeth.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Green Pit, out past the road. It's a pump outpost round an old cistern, and they pull the water up from deep rock and sell it by the can. It's clean, and it isn't cheap. Bring M's.","
","ev","str","^greenPit","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Because command bought cheap ones for the depot trucks, and I fit them by order. I've seen what one does on a hard bend. It snaps, the pedal goes to the floor, and the truck goes where the road doesn't. Otto Brann, who made the first swivel, forges his rods twice as thick. He was right, and I told command so. Nobody asks a mechanic.","
","ev","str","^talkBrakeRod","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_rods","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_brann","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The ones with his mark, yes. He signs every weld. A weld you can read is a weld you can trust. I've even seen <term=kiln>Kiln</term> riders running captured ones on their own trucks. Good steel doesn't care who owns it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_brann","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They're raiders from the camp in the south, and I'd sooner not fix a truck they've stripped. But the old woman who keeps their furnace, Dagny Brask, melts captured guns into tools. I own a few. They're decent. Don't tell command I said so.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Best metal I ever put a torch to, and the worst place to fetch it. The brass call that hull a warship. I'd like them to show me one gun mount on it. I never found one. All I ever cut there was cargo hold. And the glare off the glass around it will blind you by noon.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_sun","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Lenses cut from the fused glass, dark as smoke. I wear an old pair on bad days. I don't know who sells them now.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","ev","str","^wagon_bench","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-10":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_swivel"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_rods"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_brann"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_brann"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_glare"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_glare"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^buried","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^А, это ты. Теллер на этой неделе пьет что получше. Клади на верстак или не клади, мне работать надо.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^logged","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Опять ты. Страница так и лежит в журнале у Ковача. Командование её не читало. Если что сломалось, клади на верстак.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^admitted","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Опять ты. Теллер подписал сам, и два грузовика сняты с линии. Меня никто не спрашивал, но такого раньше не бывало. Клади на верстак.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Лена. Сломалось — клади на верстак. Если просто поговорить, то покороче. Руки заняты.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Чем ты тут занимаешься?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Что посоветуешь для моего грузовика?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Где взять дешевые запчасти?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Где взять чистую воду?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Почему проверять тормозные тяги раньше пушек?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_swivel"},{"VAR?":"asked_rods"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ты доверяешь креплениям Бранна?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_brann"},{"VAR?":"asked_brann"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что скажешь про рейдеров Обжига?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kiln"},{"VAR?":"asked_kiln"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что знаешь про Павшее солнце?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_sun"},"str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_sun"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Есть что-нибудь от бликов у Павшего солнца?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_glare"},{"VAR?":"asked_glare"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^У меня кое-что из фургона «Седьмой».","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Держу на ходу армейские грузовики. Чужие тоже, если привезут на мой верстак. Моторы, листы, крепления, что сломалось, то и чиню. Что с грузовиком, слышу по звуку, ещё пока он заезжает.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Каждая деталь что-то умеет, а чего-то не умеет. Тяжелый лист держит пули, но жрет скорость. Большая пушка вдобавок жрет место на платформе. Так что бери то, что нужно дороге, а не то, что блестит на полке. А прежде чем смотреть пушки, проверь тормозные тяги.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_swivel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^На Свалке, далеко на запад отсюда. Бригады разбирают всё, что туда притащат, так что детали уходят почти даром. Вонь горелого масла придется потерпеть. За настоящим листом езжай к Павшему солнцу, там большой корпус в кратере. Говорю это сквозь зубы.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Зеленая яма, за дорогой. Насосный пост вокруг старой цистерны: воду качают из глубокой скалы и продают канистрами. Вода чистая, но не дешевая. М захвати.","
","ev","str","^greenPit","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Потому что командование купило для грузовиков депо дешевые тормозные тяги, а я их ставлю по приказу. Я видела, что бывает с такой тягой на крутом повороте. Она лопается, педаль проваливается в пол, и грузовик летит с дороги. Отто Бранн, который сделал первую турель, кует тормозные тяги вдвое толще. Он был прав, я так и сказала командованию. Механика никто не спрашивает.","
","ev","str","^talkBrakeRod","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_rods","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_brann","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^С его клеймом — да. Он подписывает каждый шов. Шов, который можно прочесть, — шов, которому можно верить. Я даже видела, как рейдеры <term=kiln>Обжига</term> ездят с трофейными креплениями на своих грузовиках. Хорошей стали всё равно, чья она.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_brann","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Рейдеры из лагеря на юге, и грузовик, который они ободрали, я бы чинить не стала. Но старуха, что держит их печь, Дагни Браск, переплавляет трофейные пушки на инструмент. Парочка у меня есть. Годные. Командованию не говори.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Лучший металл, какого касалась моя горелка, и худшее место, где его брать. Штабные зовут этот корпус боевым кораблем. Пусть покажут мне на нем хоть одно крепление под пушку. Я не нашла. Резала я там одни грузовые трюмы. А блики от стекла вокруг к полудню тебя ослепят.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_sun","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Линзы из оплавленного стекла, темные, как дым. В плохие дни я ношу старую пару. Кто их продает теперь, не знаю.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","ev","str","^wagon_bench","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-10":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_swivel"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_rods"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_brann"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_brann"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_glare"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_glare"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Hadiza. I keep the pump and the canteen at Green Pit. Hang your rifle on the hook. Your first plate and your first cup are free. After that you pay, like everyone.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What does Green Pit sell?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why the hooks?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_hooks"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you want from me?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_want"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Water, and not much of it. The pump draws a barrel at a time from deep rock, and in a dry year it draws mud by noon.","
","^What the rock doesn't give, I buy. Salt for the pot, cloth for the tables, rations when the pot runs thin, and drums for the trucks that fill here.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_hooks","re":true},"^Because everybody drinks here. Riders from <term=kiln>Kiln</term> and soldiers from <term=nose>Nose</term> sit at the same table, and a gun on a hook can't start anything between them.","
","^The <term=farmers>Farmers</term> won't come in while the riders do. They chase riders off Bowl's roads all week, so they won't share a bench with them. If they want my water, they can drink it in their trucks.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_want","re":true},"^Bring your fights to the road, not to my door. And if you're carrying salt or cloth, sell it here before you drive on. I need it more than Bowl does.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Fill your cans before you go. The next water is a long way off.","

",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Что продается в Зеленой яме?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Зачем эти крючья?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_hooks"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Чего ты хочешь от меня?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_want"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Воду, да и той немного. Насос тянет из толщи скалы по бочке за раз, а в сухой год к полудню уже качает грязь.","
","^Чего скала не дает, я покупаю. Соль для котла, ткань на столы, пайки, когда котел пустеет, и бочки для грузовиков, которые заправляются здесь.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_hooks","re":true},"^Потому что здесь пьют все. Рейдеры из <term=kiln>Обжига</term> и солдаты с <term=nose>Носа</term> сидят за одним столом, а оружие на крюке стрельбы между ними не начнет.","
","^<term=farmers>Патруль Чаши</term> не заходит, пока здесь рейдеры. Они всю неделю гоняют рейдеров с дорог Чаши, так что на одну лавку с ними не сядут. Хотят моей воды — пусть пьют в грузовиках.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_want","re":true},"^Оставь свои драки на дороге, не тащи их к моей двери. А если везешь соль или ткань, продай здесь, прежде чем ехать дальше. Мне это нужнее, чем Чаше.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["

","^<term=dustwell>Dustwell</term> is a small square of rusted corrugated walls round a pumpjack that nods over the well. It smells of hot iron and wet stone. Pipes run from the well to the tall tanks, where water trucks wait in a line.","
","^Every hose at the tanks has a meter box on it, except one. A big grey tanker with a lantern painted on its door is filling from that one. It sits low on its springs already.","
","^A woman in a canvas apron stands at a row of dials and copies each number into a book.","
","^A man in a grey coat sits on a drum by the gate with a mug of tea. He watches the woman, not you.","
","ev","str","^perception","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ His tea has gone cold, and he hasn't drunk any. He is listening to her. ",{"->":".^.^.^.27"},null]}],"nop","
","^Water's in the tank by the lean-to drums. Read me the big dial while you fill. Every driver does, and I write the number down with your name. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":"start.14"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Read her the big dial.","/str",{"VAR?":"knows_book"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask whether the water could be leaking.","/str",{"VAR?":"knows_book"},{"VAR?":"asked_leak"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask why the tanker's meter came off.","/str",{"VAR?":"knows_book"},{"VAR?":"knows_pipe"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask what Dustwell sends out.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Ask the man on the drum what he's waiting for.","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_man"},"!",{"VAR?":"trusted"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Tell her the man on the drum is listening.","/str",{"VAR?":"trusted"},"!",{"VAR?":"watchman"},"str","^told","/str","!=","&&","str","^perception","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=",{"VAR?":"watchman"},"str","^silent","/str","==","||","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask why she picked you.","/str",{"VAR?":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==",{"VAR?":"knows_copy"},"&&",{"VAR?":"knows_why"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask what the job pays.","/str",{"VAR?":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==",{"VAR?":"knows_copy"},"&&",{"VAR?":"knows_pay"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Say you'll carry the copy.","/str",{"VAR?":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==",{"VAR?":"knows_copy"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Fill your tank and go.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_book","re":true},"^The big dial counts every barrel the pump brings up. Once a week Agnes writes its number down and sets it back to nothing, so the number is the week's whole total.","
","^You read her this week's number. She writes it in the book and your name beside it, then holds the book up so you can see the page. You've never had your name in a pump book before.","
","^Barrels a week; Pumped up, by the big dial; Bowl's trucks, by the hose meters; Passing trucks, by the hose meters; Household tanker, by its meter ","#","^head","/#","
","^Last spring; 410; 380; 10; 20 ","#","^row","/#","
","^Midsummer; 380; 340; 10; 30 ","#","^row","/#","
","^Autumn; 350; 290; 10; meter taken off ","#","^row","/#","
","^This week; 300; 220; 10; meter taken off ","#","^row","/#","
","^Every hose has a meter, and every truck that fills goes in by name. Your tank is in the passing column, under your name. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^The pump brings up less every season, and Bowl's trucks get less too. Until autumn the tanker's hose had a meter, and the columns added up to the big dial. Since the meter came off, the gap grows every week. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_leak","re":true},"^A leak that big would make the ground muddy. I check the tanks every day, and the ground is dry. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^Nothing leaves here except through a hose. One hose has no meter. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["

","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_pipe","re":true},"^The <term=senate>Senate</term> ordered it. That tanker belongs to the Archon's household. The Archon carries out what the Senate decides, and his household lives on the top terrace of <term=bowl>Bowl</term>. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^Now the tanker loads and goes, and I'm not allowed to write it down. Whatever the gap is, that's what it takes. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","

",{"->":".^.^.^.24"},null]}],"nop","

","^<term=dustwell>Пыльный колодец</term> — небольшой квадрат стен из ржавого профнастила вокруг качалки, которая мерно кивает над колодцем. Пахнет горячим железом и мокрым камнем. Трубы от колодца тянутся к высоким бакам, у которых стоит очередь водовозов.","
","^На каждом шланге у баков висит ящик с водомером, кроме одного. С него наполняют большую серую цистерну, на двери кабины у нее нарисован фонарь. Она и без того низко сидит на рессорах.","
","^У ряда счетчиков стоит женщина в холщовом фартуке. Показания она заносит в книгу.","

facts.text: Agnes's copy: the pump brings up less every season, and the household's tanker takes more. Her guess, if that goes on: Bowl's trucks get almost nothing by next autumn.

facts.name: margin_read
facts.text: Agnes's copy, last page: for Mirela, to compare with hers.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Steward Aurel Brede offered M's to lose the copy and forget the dial.

facts.name: reserve_known
facts.text: Steward: half of the tanker's water fills a tank under the top terrace. It is the Senate's reserve for a dry year, and only the Archon may open it.

facts.name: valve_read
facts.text: Top terrace: the household's tanker unloads into a stone tank. Its inlet has an empty flange where a meter used to sit.

facts.name: canal_matches
facts.text: Every barrel Agnes loaded onto Bowl's trucks reached Mirela's trough. The dial is the other half, and you read it.

facts.name: book_read
facts.text: Копия Агнес: насос с каждым сезоном дает меньше, а цистерна двора берет больше. Её прикидка: если так пойдет, к будущей осени грузовикам Чаши почти ничего не достанется.

facts.name: margin_read
facts.text: Копия Агнес, последняя страница: для Мирелы, сверить со своей книгой.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Управляющий Аурел Бреде предложил М, чтобы копия пропала, а цифра со счетчика забылась.

facts.name: reserve_known
facts.text: Управляющий: половина воды из цистерны идет в бак под верхней террасой. Это запас Сената на сухой год, открыть его может только Архонт.

facts.name: valve_read
facts.text: Верхняя терраса: цистерна двора сливает воду в каменный бак. На его приемном патрубке пустой фланец, где раньше стоял водомер.

facts.name: canal_matches
facts.text: Сколько Агнес налила водовозам Чаши, столько дошло до желоба Мирелы. Счетчик — вторая половина, и вы его прочли.

",{"->":".^.ask"},{"ask":[["#","^checkpoint: start.ask","/#","ev","str","^Is anyone still around the wagon?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What became of the wagon's crew?","/str","str","^wagonNose","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is anything left on it?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Over and out.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Not that I saw. There were tracks all over the hollow, the wide kind raiders make with chains on their tires. They were old, though. Rain's come through since and washed the edges soft. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^They walked to Nose, the way I heard it. They were lucky. Whoever ran that wagon down wasn't out for prisoners. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
",["ev","str","^story-wagon-seven","/str",{"x()":"searched","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You tell me. Sounds like you got there first. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Could be. Raiders strip what they can lift, but an Army gun is heavy. I wouldn't have wanted to carry one out of that hollow. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Over and out. Keep to the high ground. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

",{"->":".^.ask"},{"ask":[["#","^checkpoint: start.ask","/#","ev","str","^Вокруг фургона кто-нибудь остался?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Что стало с экипажем фургона?","/str","str","^wagonNose","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^На нем что-нибудь осталось?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Конец связи.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Никого не видел. По лощине кругом следы, широкие, как у рейдеров с цепями на шинах. Но старые. С тех пор прошел дождь и размыл края. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Говорят, дошли до Носа. Повезло им. Кто за ними гнался, пленных брать не собирался. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
",["ev","str","^story-wagon-seven","/str",{"x()":"searched","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Тебе лучше знать. Судя по всему, тебя туда занесло раньше меня. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Может быть. Рейдеры забирают, что могут унести, а армейская пушка тяжелая. Я бы не стал вытаскивать такую из лощины. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Конец связи. Держись высоких мест. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Hollis Brennan. I run the stills at the <term=pump_station>Pump Station</term>. Drums are stacked by the gate if you're buying. If you've got tools or batteries, I'm buying.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What does the Pump Station make?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who buys the drums?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_buyers"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Diesel, in drums. The pumpjack lifts crude off an Old World well, and the stills cook it down.","
","^The pump shakes itself loose all day, and every fix costs a wrench or a file. Its motor runs on batteries from <term=nose>Nose</term>. With weak batteries or nothing to mend it, it limps along at half speed. Half speed is half the drums.","
","ev",{"x()":"works_down"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The pump's down right now. Every drum by the gate is what's left until it turns again.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.9"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^tools","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^I'm out of tools. The next bolt that shakes loose stays loose, and the pump runs slow.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.18"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^batteries","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The batteries are flat, the last of them. The motor coughs more than it turns.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.27"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_buyers","re":true},"^The convoys load here and run them out to Nose and <term=bowl>Bowl</term>, and every outpost that sells fuel buys some.","
","^Nose burns my diesel in its forge and in the shop where it makes batteries. The tools and batteries I need come out of those fires, so the same convoys bring them back.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Mind the drums on the way out. They're full.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_buyers"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Холлис Бреннан. Я слежу за кубами на <term=pump_station>Насосной станции</term>. Если покупаешь, бочки сложены у ворот. Если у тебя есть станки или аккумуляторы, я покупаю.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Что производит Насосная станция?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Кто покупает бочки?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_buyers"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Солярку в бочках. Качалка поднимает сырую нефть из скважины старого мира, а кубы её варят.","
","^Насос весь день разбалтывается от тряски, и на каждый ремонт уходит ключ или напильник. Мотор работает на аккумуляторах с <term=nose>Носа</term>. Со слабыми аккумуляторами или когда чинить нечем, он еле тянет вполсилы. А вполсилы — это вдвое меньше бочек.","
","ev",{"x()":"works_down"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Насос сейчас стоит. Все бочки у ворот — это всё, что осталось, пока он снова не заработает.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.9"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^tools","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^У меня кончились станки. Следующий разболтавшийся болт так и останется незатянутым, и насос станет крутиться медленно.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.18"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^batteries","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Аккумуляторы сели, до последнего. Мотор больше чихает, чем крутится.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.27"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_buyers","re":true},"^Колонны грузятся здесь и везут их на Нос и в <term=bowl>Чашу</term>, да и на каждом посту, где продают топливо, берут понемногу.","
","^Нос сжигает мою солярку в кузне и в цехе, где делает аккумуляторы. Нужные мне станки и аккумуляторы выходят из этого огня, так что те же колонны везут их обратно.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Смотри не задень бочки на выезде. Они полные.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"counter_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_buyers"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}
